  <h1>CSU ROSS Sensor Network</h1>

```{r load-metadata}
download_path <- "data/collated/sensor/hydroshare_pub"
metadata_file <- file.path(download_path, "CSU_ROSS_sonde_location_metadata.csv")

if (!file.exists(metadata_file)) {
  stop("Metadata file not found at expected location: ", metadata_file)
}

# read_csv() already returns ISO-8601 dates as POSIXct; this also handles
# m/d/yy text dates if the file is ever saved that way
to_utc <- function(x) {
  if (inherits(x, "POSIXct")) with_tz(x, "UTC") else parse_date_time(x, orders = c("mdy", "ymd"), tz = "UTC")
}

today_utc <- as.POSIXct(Sys.Date(), tz = "UTC")

# One row per DEPLOYMENT (a site can have several: same `site` ID, different
# location). `deployment_id` is the unique key for a site + location + window.
metadata <- read_csv(metadata_file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(
    deployment_id   = row_number(),
    current         = as.logical(current),
    data_start_date = to_utc(data_start_date),
    # sites that are still deployed run through today
    data_end_date   = if_else(current, today_utc, to_utc(data_end_date)),
    min_year        = year(data_start_date),
    max_year        = year(data_end_date),
    year_range      = paste0(min_year, "-", max_year),
    # Half-open window [start, end-of-end-day). Back-to-back deployments at a
    # site (e.g. elc: ends 2023-09-20, next starts 2023-09-21) never overlap,
    # so each reading matches exactly one deployment.
    join_start = data_start_date,
    join_end   = data_end_date + days(1)
  )
```

```{r load-sensor-data}
data_dirs <- list.dirs(download_path, recursive = FALSE) %>%
  setdiff(file.path(download_path, "metadata"))

cleaned_files <- list.files(data_dirs, pattern = "cleaned.*\\.parquet$", full.names = TRUE)

cleaned_data <- map(cleaned_files, read_parquet) %>%
  bind_rows()
```

```{r join-and-summarize}
# Sensor data only carries `site`, so assign each reading to a deployment by
# matching site AND date window (this is what separates multiple deployments
# of the same site)
cleaned_data_with_metadata <- cleaned_data %>%
  left_join(
    metadata %>% select(site, deployment_id, join_start, join_end),
    by = join_by(
      site,
      DateTime_UTC >= join_start,
      DateTime_UTC < join_end
    )
  )

# Date range covered by each parameter within each deployment
param_summary <- cleaned_data_with_metadata %>%
  filter(!is.na(value_final), !is.na(deployment_id)) %>%
  group_by(site, deployment_id, parameter) %>%
  summarize(
    start_dt = min(DateTime_UTC, na.rm = TRUE),
    end_dt   = max(DateTime_UTC, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups  = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(metadata %>% select(deployment_id, current), by = "deployment_id") %>%
  # current deployments are shown as running through today
  mutate(end_dt = if_else(current, today_utc, end_dt)) %>%
  select(-current)
```

```{r build-popups}
deployment_popups <- param_summary %>%
  mutate(
    param_row = paste0(
      "<tr>",
        "<td><b>", parameter, "</b></td>",
        "<td>", format(start_dt, "%Y-%m-%d"), " to ", format(end_dt, "%Y-%m-%d"), "</td>",
      "</tr>"
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(deployment_id) %>%
  summarize(
    param_table = paste0(
      "<table class='popup-table'>",
        "<tr class='popup-table-header'>",
          "<th>Parameter</th>",
          "<th>Record Window</th>",
        "</tr>",
        paste(param_row, collapse = ""),
      "</table>"
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Overall span per site, across all of its deployments
site_spans <- metadata %>%
  group_by(site) %>%
  summarize(
    site_span = paste0(min(min_year), "-", max(max_year)),
    n_deployments = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# One marker per deployment location. Historical deployments are drawn first
# so current ones sit on top.
sites_sf <- metadata %>%
  left_join(site_spans, by = "site") %>%
  left_join(deployment_popups, by = "deployment_id") %>%
  mutate(
    status = if_else(current, "Current deployment", "Historical deployment"),
    popup_content = paste0(
      "<div class='site-popup'>",
        "<h4>", site_name, "</h4>",
        "<p class='site-popup-meta'>",
          coalesce(site_description, "No description available"), "<br>",
          "<b>Status:</b> ", status, "<br>",
          "<b>This deployment:</b> ",
            format(data_start_date, "%Y-%m-%d"), " to ",
            if_else(current, "present", format(data_end_date, "%Y-%m-%d")), "<br>",
          "<b>Site span (all deployments):</b> ", site_span,
          if_else(n_deployments > 1,
                  paste0(" (", n_deployments, " deployments)"), ""),
        "</p>",
        "<b class='site-popup-label'>Parameter Date Ranges:</b>",
        coalesce(param_table, "<p class='site-popup-empty'>No parameter records</p>"),
      "</div>"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(current) %>%   # FALSE (historical) first, TRUE (current) last = on top
  st_as_sf(coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = 4326)

sites_current    <- filter(sites_sf, current)
sites_historical <- filter(sites_sf, !current)
```

```{r load-flowlines, cache=TRUE}
# Poudre River watershed, HUC8 = 10190007
poudre_huc8 <- get_huc(id = "10190007", type = "huc08")

poudre_flowlines <- get_nhdplus(
  AOI         = poudre_huc8,
  realization = "flowline"
) %>%
  st_transform(4326)
```

```{r render-map}
# ---- Site ordering: edit this vector to reorder everything -----------------
site_order <- c(
  "joei", "cbri", "chd", "pfal", "sfm", "lbea", "penn", "pbr", "pman", "pbd",
  "bellvue", "salyer", "udall", "riverbend", "cottonwood", "elc", "archery",
  "riverbluffs", "boxcreek", "springcreek"
)
# safety net: any site not listed above goes to the end instead of becoming NA
site_order <- c(site_order, setdiff(unique(sites_sf$site), site_order))

# Everything up to and including this site (in site_order) counts as
# "Canyon mouth & upstream"; everything after it is "Downstream"
canyon_mouth_site <- "pbd"
upstream_sites    <- site_order[seq_len(match(canyon_mouth_site, site_order))]
region_levels     <- c("Upper CLP", "PWQN")

# site_name levels follow the order of `site` in site_order
site_name_order <- sites_sf %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  distinct(site, site_name) %>%
  arrange(match(site, site_order)) %>%
  pull(site_name) %>%
  unique()

sites_sf <- sites_sf %>%
  mutate(
    site      = factor(site, levels = site_order),
    site_name = factor(site_name, levels = site_name_order)
  )

# ---- Styling: color = site, shape = region + current/historical -------------
# 10 high-contrast colors. Shape separates the two regions, so the same 10
# colors are reused within each region (shape + color is unique per site).
site_colors <- c(
  "#E41A1C", "#377EB8", "#4DAF4A", "#984EA3", "#FF7F00",
  "#A65628", "#F781BF", "#17BECF", "#BCBD22", "#444444"
)

site_style <- sites_sf %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  distinct(site, site_name) %>%
  arrange(site) %>%
  mutate(region = factor(
    if_else(as.character(site) %in% upstream_sites, region_levels[1], region_levels[2]),
    levels = region_levels
  )) %>%
  group_by(region) %>%
  mutate(color = rep_len(site_colors, n())) %>%
  ungroup()

sites_sf <- sites_sf %>%
  left_join(select(site_style, site, region, color), by = "site") %>%
  mutate(
    # triangle up / down = upstream current / historical
    # square / diamond   = downstream current / historical
    shape = case_when(
      region == region_levels[1] &  current ~ "tri_up",
      region == region_levels[1] & !current ~ "tri_down",
      current                               ~ "square",
      TRUE                                  ~ "diamond"
    ),
    size = if_else(current, 30, 18),
    op   = if_else(current, 1, 0.75)
  ) %>%
  # historical (FALSE) first, current (TRUE) last so current markers sit on top
  arrange(current, site)

sites_current    <- filter(sites_sf, current)
sites_historical <- filter(sites_sf, !current)

# ---- SVG helpers ------------------------------------------------------------
shape_svg <- function(shape, fill, size = 24, opacity = 1) {
  geom <- switch(shape,
    tri_up   = '<polygon points="12,2 22.5,21.5 1.5,21.5"/>',
    tri_down = '<polygon points="1.5,2.5 22.5,2.5 12,22"/>',
    square   = '<rect x="3" y="3" width="18" height="18"/>',
    diamond  = '<polygon points="12,1.5 22.5,12 12,22.5 1.5,12"/>'
  )
  paste0(
    '<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="', size, '" height="', size,
    '" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><g fill="', fill, '" fill-opacity="', opacity,
    '" stroke="#1a1a1a" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linejoin="round">',
    geom, '</g></svg>'
  )
}

marker_icons <- function(d) {
  d <- st_drop_geometry(d)
  urls <- pmap_chr(
    list(d$shape, d$color, d$op),
    function(s, f, o) {
      paste0("data:image/svg+xml;charset=utf-8,",
             URLencode(shape_svg(s, f, 24, o), reserved = TRUE))
    }
  )
  icons(
    iconUrl     = urls,
    iconWidth   = d$size, iconHeight  = d$size,
    iconAnchorX = d$size / 2, iconAnchorY = d$size / 2
  )
}

# ---- Custom legend: one column per region + a shape key --------------------
legend_column <- function(region_name, shape) {
  rows <- filter(site_style, region == region_name)
  items <- map2_chr(rows$color, as.character(rows$site_name), function(col, nm) {
    paste0(
      '<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;margin:2px 0;">',
        shape_svg(shape, col, 14), "<span>", nm, "</span>",
      "</div>"
    )
  })
  paste0(
    "<div><div style='font-weight:600;margin-bottom:4px;'>", region_name, "</div>",
    paste(items, collapse = ""), "</div>"
  )
}

key_item <- function(shape, size, label) {
  paste0(
    '<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;margin:2px 0;">',
      shape_svg(shape, "#bbbbbb", size), "<span>", label, "</span>",
    "</div>"
  )
}

legend_html <- paste0(
  '<div style="background:rgba(255,255,255,0.93);padding:10px 12px;',
  'border-radius:6px;box-shadow:0 1px 5px rgba(0,0,0,.3);',
  'font:12px/1.3 sans-serif;color:#2c3e50;">',
    '<div style="display:flex;gap:20px;">',
      legend_column(region_levels[1], "tri_up"),
      legend_column(region_levels[2], "square"),
    "</div>",
    '<hr style="margin:8px 0;border:0;border-top:1px solid #ddd;">',
    '<div style="display:flex;gap:20px;">',
      "<div>", key_item("tri_up", 16, "Current"),
               key_item("tri_down", 11, "Historical"), "</div>",
      "<div>", key_item("square", 16, "Current"),
               key_item("diamond", 11, "Historical"), "</div>",
    "</div>",
  "</div>"
)

# ---- Map --------------------------------------------------------------------
river_group <- "Poudre River (HUC8 10190007)"

leaflet(width = "100%", height = "650px") %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.WorldTopoMap, group = "Topographic") %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$OpenStreetMap, group = "Clean") %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.WorldImagery, group = "Satellite") %>%
  addPolylines(
    data    = poudre_flowlines,
    color   = "#2C7FB8",
    weight  = 1.5,
    opacity = 0.7,
    group   = river_group
  ) %>%
  # Historical deployments: smaller, slightly transparent
  addMarkers(
    data  = sites_historical,
    icon  = marker_icons(sites_historical),
    popup = ~popup_content,
    label = ~paste0(site_name, " (historical)"),
    group = "Historical deployments"
  ) %>%
  # Current deployments: larger, drawn on top
  addMarkers(
    data    = sites_current,
    icon    = marker_icons(sites_current),
    popup   = ~popup_content,
    label   = ~paste0(site_name, " (current)"),
    group   = "Current deployments",
    options = markerOptions(zIndexOffset = 1000)
  ) %>%
  addControl(html = legend_html, position = "bottomright") %>%
  addLayersControl(
    baseGroups    = c("Topographic", "Clean", "Satellite"),
    overlayGroups = c("Current deployments", "Historical deployments", river_group),
    options       = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)
  )
```
